items.title: Release v5.12.0
items.summary:
Release v5.12.0
New Model additions
MiniMax-M3-VL

MiniMax-M3-VL is the vision-language member of the MiniMax-M3 family that pairs a CLIP-style vision tower with 3D rotary position embeddings with the MiniMax-M3 text backbone. It uses a mixed dense/sparse Mixture-of-Experts decoder with SwiGLU-OAI gated experts and a lightning indexer for block-sparse attention. The model processes images through a Conv3d patch embedding system and includes specialized components for efficient multimodal understanding and generation.
Links: Documentation

items.title: v0.30.8
items.summary:
What's Changed

Fixed ollama launch selecting the wrong provider in some cases
Improved prompt caching by decoupling it from context shift for better KV cache reuse
More stable MLX inference with hardened linear and embedding layers
MLX runner now creates snapshots during prompt processing and speculative decoding for improved reliability
Improved recurrent model support with per-boundary states from the gated-delta kernels
